text:
morgan: Heads up — CI caught a docs-lint failure on the 429 error-ref page. It looks like a bunch of external links we rely on have 404s (link rot) and the linter rule `errref-link-check` is blocking merges. PR is #1824.

tara: ack. can you paste the failing lines? I can do a quick pass to either update or point to archived copies.

docs-bot: CI: docs-lint failed for PR #1824 — rule errref-link-check — 6 broken links found in content/errors/429.md. See https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1824/checks

morgan: Copying the two most urgent ones: `https://old-posts.example.com/ratelimiting` (404) and `https://thirdparty.example/status-codes#too-many-requests` (redirect loop). Also a sample snippet reference to `sdk/v1/429-handling.md` that's been moved.

samir: I can replace the old-posts link with the archived snapshot on archive.org, but we should prefer internal docs or our new troubleshooting playbook. I'll open a tiny PR on top of #1824 unless someone objects.

linh: @morgan re: the SDK snippet — the file was moved during the sdk-snippets reorg. New path is `sdk/handlers/retry-429.md`. We should update the include directive in 429.md to point to that. I can update in the same PR.

tara: sounds good. small checklist: 1) swap broken external links to either internal playbook or archive.org 2) update include to new SDK snippet path 3) run docs-lint locally (`make docs-lint`) 4) ping devex for snippet style check.

morgan: putting those as commits on #1824. assigning to @tara for link choices and @linh for snippet path change.

devex: quick style note — when we update the SDK snippet, keep the client-agnostic pseudo-code example at top level and add language-specific variants as collapsible sections. Also add the `retry-after` example for 429s.

tara: will do. for the external API link, propose we replace with our internal playbook: `/playbooks/rate-limits/overview.md` and add a short blurb: "If you rely on third-party rate limits, prefer server-side backoff and client windowing — see playbook."

morgan: updated PR description with that change and added the archive.org fallback for the other link. pushed commit 9f3a2b.

docs-bot: CI: docs-lint passed on branch morgan/429-link-fixes (after commit 9f3a2b). spellcheck still has two suggested edits.

samir: I grabbed the spell suggestions and pushed a tiny commit to normalize capitalization in headings.

linh: updated the include directive and moved the inline code block to use the new snippet. Example now shows `client.retryOn(429, { backoff: exponential(500, 2) })` which matches SDK surface.

morgan: thanks — running a final local `make docs-serve` to sanity-check rendering. Looks good.

tara: one more ask — can docs team add a short note in the runbook about monitoring link rot? maybe a weekly linkcheck job that files issues automatically. I'll file a follow-up.

morgan: filed issue #1880 to track linkcheck automation and tagging of archived replacements.

devex: great. once CI green and no further comments, we can merge and backport a tiny note to the consolidated error-ref index. :thumbsup:

morgan: CI still shows one flaky example test unrelated to link changes — flagging @devex to decide if we should merge and fix that in a follow-up.

devex: if it's flaky and unrelated, go ahead with merge and open a small follow-up PR for the example test. keep the changelog entry small: "fix: 429 docs link rot + snippet path".

morgan: merging now. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround!

tara: nice one :tada:

linh: thanks :herb:

samir: o/

docs-bot: PR #1824 merged into main by morgan at 1743219948.
